title: Agent
description: A durable agent record as stored by the control plane. Creation manifests may omit system-assigned fields (created_at, revision) — see ADR 0011.

revision.description: Incremented on every change to the agent definition; governance proposals reference the revision they target.

skills.description: NOT YET ENFORCED: recorded on the agent and shown in context, but no control-plane logic reads it. There is no skill registry or loader yet.

model_config.description: Which model this agent thinks with. Part of the durable definition, like its permissions: an agent that reasons about supply-chain security may warrant a different model, or a deeper thinking level, than one that files chores. Absent means the organization's configured default.

model.description: Provider-specific model id, e.g. claude-opus-5 or anthropic/claude-opus-4 on OpenRouter.

thinking.description: Reasoning depth and token spend. Mapped to each provider's own parameter; providers without one ignore it.

memory_policy.description: NOT YET ENFORCED: recorded on the agent and shown in context, but no control-plane logic reads it. Memory operations are driven by the agent's own proposals; no retention, distillation, or archival policy is applied automatically.

relationships.description: NOT YET ENFORCED: recorded on the agent and shown in context, but no control-plane logic reads it. The context builder shows every colleague from the agent directory rather than routing by declared relationship.

subscriptions.description: Inbox wake-up filter (ADR 0008): which delivered items make this agent eligible to run. Absent means wake on everything.
